scope: HTTP loopback -> real auth/user routes, services, Prisma/MySQL and Redis; full server bootstrap/UI not included
conclusion: Old admin access tokens still authorize real user listing after logout-all, deactivation or downgrade; refresh/new login obey persisted state.
limitations: No global server bootstrap, WebSocket or UI
Webhook egress stubbed; no user/session repository or token/guard stubs
Fixtures seeded directly; subsequent mutations use real HTTP routes
Observed until immediate request; no claim beyond JWT expiry
Fixture bcrypt cost 4 only reduces seeding time; production auth verify and generated password remain real.
commands: docker run --rm --label nodeaccess.diagnosis=NA-0174-auth -p 127.0.0.1::<port> <disposable mysql/redis> (random credentials withheld)
node node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db push --skip-generate --schema apps/backend/prisma/schema.prisma (disposable DATABASE_URL)
docker rm -f -v <exact names created by runner>
preparation_failures: Initial root-only MySQL account rejected mapped-host connection; all containers removed; corrected harness to dedicated diagnosis DB user, no root privilege widening.

field_clarification.logout.fresh_login_status: Value200 is GET /users using newly issued token; password+TOTP login asserted separately by harness.

digestRepresentationNote: Três hashes históricos representados como algorithm/digest para distinguir evidência de credencial; valores dos digests preservados.
